scientific_integrity: Analytical proof covers all parameter values and arbitrary compact target sets. Finite numerical checks are supplementary; no external mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The target must be nonempty, norm-compact, absolutely convex, and contained in complex C(Omega) for a nonempty compact Hausdorff Omega.
The Hilbert-space construction may be nonseparable; no minimum Hilbert dimension or stability theorem is claimed.
The sharp scalar square-zero q-numerical radius was known in rank-one literature; novelty is restricted to uniform function-valued realization of every admissible q.
Priority comparisons remain best-knowledge and are not independent publication-priority certification.
title: Simultaneous \(q\)-numerical realization by pairwise-annihilating operator families
